81. Noreen handed a signed paper to the sergeant of the guard.
82. Miracle pleaded with Noreen for mercy.
83. Noreen informed Miracle that she was to have six months in prison.
84. Miracle adjusted her disordered garments and announced to the soldiers that she was to be released.
85. M. Madeleine ordered that Miracle be set at liberty.


Below is a list of possible subsequent events:

['M. Madeleine revealed to Noreen that the local official had made a significant error.', 'M. Madeleine clarified to Noreen that the neighbor was mistaken in his accusations.', 'M. Madeleine told Noreen that the traveler had been misled by the rumors.', 'M. Madeleine explained to Noreen that the townsman was in the wrong.', 'M. Madeleine informed Noreen that the passerby had misunderstood the situation.', 'M. Madeleine asserted to Noreen that the merchant had acted improperly.']

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.
references: M. Madeleine explained to Noreen that the townsman was in the wrong.
